_note: Shelf layout and routines for teach.py. Slot names are free text; each slot needs two taught poses, '<slot>/front' (in front of the slot, far enough out that a held filter clears the shelf) and '<slot>/in' (gripper around the filter's handle, filter seated). Each side's 'carry' pose is where the arm turns between sides: pulled in close to the base, holding a filter level. Speeds are degrees per second (gripper: percent per second). missed_grab_at: if the gripper closes more than this fraction of the way from open to fully closed, it's holding nothing. wrist_camera: part of the wrist camera's name (see vision/cameras.py), or null for none. With it, routines read each filter's marker from in front of its slot (to check it's the right filter and keep inventory.json up to date) and save a photo each time a filter comes out. If the camera isn't plugged in, they carry on without it.
